style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, mountain noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something big crosses or fills the lens: a bill, her tail, the marmot's face, the herd, the dust. Lens blanked nine times. Banner snaps and dust streams all clip, speech seconds included
camera_moves: wide; close-ups come from the animals and the paper
character: a lean puma in an embroidered coat, lounging in a gilded velvet armchair, eyes half closed, a huge DIAMOND RING on her finger, bills under one paw, an iron chain in the other; she never hurries
cast: the MARMOT: fat, chewing without pause, never running, chained like a lapdog at her chair. The HERD: goats and deer at full speed, never stopping
props: BANNER: ragged holed cloth on poles over the cliff, flapping hard, painted with a smiling top-hatted showman and a THREE-FINGERED hand making a profit sign. CHAIR: carved gold and red velvet. BILLS: pale percent slips
prop_continuity: stack shrinks: full at 0.0, half at 4.2, gone at 8.0; the ring catches the sun every shot
environment: sunlit ledge, wind-raked grass, dust streaming down the valley all clip, blue sky, sheer drop
lighting: blazing high-altitude noon, hard sun, crisp shadows, glints off the diamond

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: lazy satisfied female voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 1.6-3.0 is ONE unbroken phrase, no break at 2.3; pauses only at 1.3-1.6, 3.0-4.2, 7.0-7.5; 4.2 and 5.6 run together; voiceless after 8.0
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: cloth cracking, paper rustle and slap, chain clinking, chewing; a thud at 3.0; 5.6-7.0 loud bleating and hooves, fading after 8.8

timeline.a: silent. A bill flies INTO THE LENS, blanks the frame, peels away: she is deep in the gilded chair, torn banner cracking above
she leans out of the chair at the lens until her face fills the frame; the ring sparks into the camera
silent. The chain snaps taut across the frame, a bill spins past the lens
she throws her whole body around in the chair, tail sweeping the lens black end to end
no break in her voice. The wind rips a bill off the stack and SLAPS it flat onto the lens, covering the whole frame, then peels it off across her grinning muzzle
silent, the loudest hit. The fat MARMOT slams into the lens on his chain, chewing face filling the frame, then the stack bursts around him and blanks it twice
she stretches full length out of the chair as the wind drags the last paper across the frame
no breath. The herd tears edge to edge under the banner in a wall of dust, hooves hammering
silent, the only stop in her voice. The herd's dust wall rolls over the lens and blanks the frame; only her jaw and the ring move
she whips her head into the lens, muzzle filling the frame, eyes opening wide
silent. She sweeps the last bills over the edge; through the paper the herd reaches the drop, the first goats go over
silent. She rises from the chair in one graceful movement and looks down: the back rows shove the front and the herd pours into the abyss under the banner

must_appear: the diamond ring, the gilded chair, the chained marmot, the holed banner with the showman and three-fingered sign, her graceful rise, the herd falling into the abyss
negative_prompt: letters, numbers, cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, live people, a second puma, slow motion, speed ramp, the herd standing still, the chain breaking, a talking head with nothing else moving, silence in the tail, accented Russian
